article.story: RIVERSIDE, Calif. -- — Kaleb Smith scored 14 points and Nate Pickens hit a go-ahead 3-pointer with four seconds left to rally UC Riverside to a 60-58 victory over UC Davis on Thursday night. Smith went 4 of 7 from the field (4 for 4 from 3-point range) for the Highlanders (14-8, 7-3 Big West Conference). Rikus Schulte scored 10 points and grabbed five rebounds. The Aggies (12-9, 6-4) were led by Ty Johnson with 20 points and eight rebounds. Connor Sevilla added 15 points and Carl Daughtery Jr. scored nine. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
